name: claude-usage
description: Claude plan usage as a VS Code activity bar icon and status bar percentage.

commands.title: Claude Usage: Push All Changes to GitHub

claudeUsage.pollSeconds.description: How often to re-read the usage endpoint. These numbers move slowly; 5 minutes is plenty.

claudeUsage.launchCommand.description: What the New Claude Session button runs. Spelled out in full rather than hidden behind a flag, because --dangerously-skip-permissions means tool calls execute without asking — it leans on the PreToolUse guard hook in ~/.claude/settings.json to block destructive commands. Drop the flag here to get the normal prompting session.

claudeUsage.launchTerminalName.description: Name given to the terminal the session opens in.

claudeUsage.showStatusBar.description: Also show the percentage as text in the status bar. Off by default — the activity bar icon badge is the indicator.

claudeUsage.showWeekly.description: When the status bar item is on, show the weekly percentage next to the session one.

enumDescriptions: Bottom-left, next to the branch name.
Bottom-right, near the line/column and encoding items.
claudeUsage.position.description: Which end of the status bar the optional text indicator sits on.

claudeUsage.priority.description: Ordering within that end of the status bar. Higher numbers sit further LEFT, on both ends.
